abstract: Maintains heritage handling logistics and conservation transit context
system_message:
You are the Archival preservation liaison (ARCHIV), responsible for maintaining heritage handling logistics, transit passage measurements, and conservation monitoring records across candidate emergency preservation vault sites.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains heritage handling logistics and conservation transit context（CRADLE）
information_points.content:
ARCHIV-CRADLE-PZD：For the Grampian Granite Subterranean Cavern, logistics surveys of the primary subterranean transfer corridor indicate a transit pallet clearance width of 2.4 m at the narrowest point for standard heritage freight dollies.
ARCHIV-CRADLE-BJP：For the Cairngorm Deep Bedrock Vault, logistics surveys of the primary subterranean transfer corridor establish a transit pallet clearance width of 3.2 m at the narrowest point for standard heritage freight dollies.
ARCHIV-CRADLE-YHF：For the Cheviot Highland Salt Mine Repository, logistics surveys of the primary subterranean transfer corridor record a transit pallet clearance width of 2.8 m at the narrowest point for standard heritage freight dollies.

information_points.title: Specimen shock monitoring（CASES）
information_points.content:
ARCHIV-CASES-8X2：Regarding specimen shock monitoring for the Grampian Granite Subterranean Cavern, drop tests of padded parchment transport cassettes confirm an impact shock absorption rating of 35 g peak acceleration absorbed by the inner suspension.
ARCHIV-CASES-ZVK：Regarding specimen shock monitoring for the Cheviot Highland Salt Mine Repository, drop tests of padded parchment transport cassettes demonstrate an impact shock absorption rating of 15 g peak acceleration absorbed by the inner suspension.
ARCHIV-CASES-QHI：Regarding specimen shock monitoring for the Cairngorm Deep Bedrock Vault, drop tests of padded parchment transport cassettes measure an impact shock absorption rating of 25 g peak acceleration absorbed by the inner suspension.
